addressed_findings: Parent-count accumulation converted to size_t before addition.
CUDA chunk helper synchronizes owning current stream and rejects incomplete reads before upload.
External sampling uses start/end acknowledgments and joins sampler before verification allocations; actual intervals are reported.
Documentation encoding corrected and benchmark pre-run GPU load distinguished from earlier heavily loaded correctness runs.
limitations: Phase-specific savings are not additive. Startup working set is not a measured long-running MD average, and lifetime highwater includes earlier construction.
RNG timing uses Windows NUL output and synthetic bounded zero input; it is not disk/compression/full-checkpoint/FAH wrap-up throughput.
Reorder phase includes setPositions, computeVirtualSites and three forced reorders. No meaningful reorder speedup established; lifetime peak is essentially unchanged.
Requested 1ms sampling produced about 15.6ms intervals and 21-27 samples per trial. Sampled maxima are lower-bound observations of phase peaks; their difference is not a lower bound on exact savings.

One original baseline LangevinMiddle single stochastic temperature failure is preserved. Controlled integrator/initial-temperature seed suites passed separately; one massless initialization remains unseeded.
Partial transfer/reordering failures are not transactional. Existing ForceInfo destructor/ownership issue remains deferred; no cleanup/vtable repair is included.
No actual FAH work unit, PPD, end-to-end startup/wrap-up or VRAM saving established. OpenCL/HIP and full static CUDA runtime are unvalidated; compilation checks only.
Tested Windows RTX5090, driver621.01, CUDA13.4.92; other hardware/driver configurations unvalidated.
